title: Concept: Overdraft limit served in a response
description: An overdraft limit value in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The limit describes how far the account can go negative, which is a credit decision and a payment-fraud signal when it appears next to the balance.
applicability: Deployments that render an overdraft limit value into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The limit describes how far the account can go negative, which is a credit decision and a payment-fraud signal when it appears next to the balance.
